description: End-of-day OHLCV candles for one ticker, daily or weekly (weeks dated by Sunday). Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor, or use store_as with fetch_all for the whole range in one call.

adjustment.description: split (default), split_dividend (total return) or raw (as traded).

append.description: Add rows to an existing store_as table instead of replacing it.

fetch_all.description: Follow every page into store_as in this one call.

store_as.description: Table name: store rows in SQLite, return only a summary. Read with query_data.

name: get_ohlcv
